saw_lines: Mums don’t pick a bottle by brand. They pick the one that suits their chest, then keep buying the same size.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a mum decides whether the bottle fits her chest.
Your 30 live ads carry no proof number, so lead the next batch with one real count, like reviews collected or orders shipped.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a new mum scrolling past has no reason to trust the claim. Lead the next batch with one real count, such as reviews collected or orders shipped, on the creative.
10 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, while 14 go to the personalised bottle page. Every step loses mums who came for one bottle. Point each of the 10 to the product page its ad shows.
Your site promotes free shipping, yet 0 of 30 ads mention it, so new buyers get no reason to act. Open the first line of new ads with free shipping, then name the bottle they are about to order.

Your 30 ads open with 16 different stories, and the biggest leads 4 of them, so no single reason to buy ever repeats long enough to stick. Pick the two strongest stories and make three fresh ads from each.
